notes.note: "Charles Jones's Hoyle's Games Imrpoved, including thirty-four fashionable games, with directions for playing and betting thereon; in a pocket volume, price 6 s. bound in red."
The text on skittles is taken from the broadside
Rules and instructions for playing at skittles
By a Society of Gentlemen. London: printed for G. Kearsley, 1786. (ESTC
). There is a later reprint of the broadside and perhaps the reprint is what is advertised on A2v(iv).
